sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Rat Hunting is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. You know, a few days ago I caught myself thinking that Tarkov had somehow become... quieter. At least for me. Then yesterday I realized that feeling was misleading. Someone's been deliberately jamming signals in my area of operation. I don't like it, but I don't want to scare them off just yet. You understand why, they could always come back with something more sophisticated. So first I'm going to try a little trick to work around the jammers without alerting whoever's behind them. To do that, I'll need a few components... Here's the list."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Mechanic to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find the item in raid: PC CPU
- Hand over the item
- Find the item in raid: Rechargeable battery
- Hand over the item
- Find the item in raid: Printed circuit board
- Hand over the item

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"I'll put it together quickly. Though, of course, I'm no match for Elektronik."
